requirement: Students read short, phonetically controlled passages to demonstrate accurate word recognition. Focus: Building accuracy in reading grade-level decodable text. Examples: 'The cat sat on the mat.', 'Sam had a fast car.', 'The bird can sing.', 'I like to play with my toy.', 'The clouds are big.', 'Help the girl find her book.', 'They will reach the top.', 'The sun is hot today.' Constraints: Measure accuracy and word-reading time automatically within the decodable-reader.
